<!-- DO NOT file security issues as public GitHub issues. See SECURITY.md. -->

Please report security issues **privately**:

- Email: security@ilysom0611.dev
- GitHub Security Advisories: https://github.com/ilysom0611/doc-translator/security/advisories/new

Include:

1. A short description of the issue.
2. Steps to reproduce (or a synthetic example that demonstrates the bug).
3. The expected and actual behavior.
4. The version / commit SHA affected.
5. Whether you would like public credit in the CHANGELOG.

Maintainer response target: 7 days (see SECURITY.md).

This public form is provided so that the link from SECURITY.md resolves
to something more useful than a 404; please use one of the two channels
above instead of submitting here.
